questions: The exclusion in Q1 can grammatically describe non-scheme money received or held in Hong Kong, or money outside the composite category of scheme money received or held in Hong Kong. Neither parse supplies a defensible transfer-agent exception to the affirmative target clause; resolving the exclusion's full reach would require a separate issue.
What incorporated definitions and Schedule 11 provisions govern the external classifications and continuing duties? The supplied dependency is missing.

citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, regardless of the role played by such LC.

In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

readings.distinction: Only one substantive target reading is defensible. Attachment of the final regardless-clause to the applicability proposition or more locally to the LC's conduct both leave the stated conditions intact and make transfer-agent status irrelevant. Reading it as a transfer-agent exception reverses its wording; reading it as dispensing with the RA13-course condition extends role-independence beyond its grammatical object. The separate Schedule 11 sentence preserves expectations outside this selected trigger without adding another condition to it.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] True means that the funds meet the supplied RA13-context, scheme-money and Hong Kong receipt-or-holding conditions together. Acting as a Transfer Agent neither defeats nor independently satisfies this antecedent. A false result does not determine Schedule 11 duties or whole-law compliance.

vocabulary_concerns: ra13_context bundles actor identity, handling and the course-of-RA13 requirement; the vocabulary cannot separately test their attachment or attribution between the LC and its AE.
in_hong_kong is defined specifically for scheme money. It cannot independently locate non-scheme money when comparing the possible attachments of the exclusion's negation.
No supplied fact represents Schedule 11 duties, their modality or their satisfaction. They remain continuing qualifications outside this Boolean.
The incorporated scheme-money definition is not supplied. Its classification must remain external and unknown unless supported; transfer_agent cannot substitute for it.
